name: Shangri-La Paris
description:
Shangri-La Paris is a Shangri-La hotel set in the former Paris residence of Prince Roland Bonaparte, with 101 rooms, of which nearly half overlook the Eiffel Tower.
The hotel has a daylight-filled indoor pool, parking, room service, and a series of grand ballrooms across the historic building.
Dining is led by a Michelin-starred Cantonese restaurant, with the 270-square-metre Roland Bonaparte suite classified as a historical monument and preserved with the Prince's original princely décor.
